meta.title: Codex WS
meta.description: GPT models over the Codex-style Responses WebSocket transport (Codex CLI's supports_websockets): no extra model channel — the openai provider is intercepted in place, with the endpoint and key resolved from the local Codex CLI config (~/.codex/config.toml). The composer WS/SSE button appears only while the current model is an OpenAI one.
